recommendations.title: Gateway Service Supervisor
recommendations.job: Restart, health-check and re-bind the Hermes gateway and its web UI ports (9119 etc.) from outside the agent's own process.
recommendations.why_plugin: The agent is explicitly blocked from restarting the gateway it runs inside, so this cannot be a skill or a shell command — it needs an out-of-process supervisor that owns the ports and can arm a detached systemd unit and persist which port serves which UI.
